case.title: Preference tokens restored with Java object serialization

mechanism.description: explicit data-only token format read field by field (no object deserialization)
guidance: OWASP Deserialization Cheat Sheet, 'Using Alternative Data Formats': 'A great reduction of risk is achieved by avoiding native (de)serialization formats. By switching to a pure data format like JSON or XML ...' https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Deserialization_Cheat_Sheet.html

Oracle, Secure Coding Guidelines for Java SE, Section 8: 'Deserialization of untrusted data is inherently dangerous and should be avoided.' https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/seccodeguide.html
